title: hedyotis hedyotidea
intro: Hedyotis hedyotidea, commonly known as the 'False Thyroid', is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it beneficial for heart health and immune system support. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as reducing blood pressure, and exhibiting anti-diabetic and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis hedyotidea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
